what: Shutterstock's acquisition press release describes Envato Elements as "a leading unlimited multi-asset subscription offering" that complements Shutterstock's existing offering, expands reach to freelancers, hobbyists, small businesses and agencies, and adds 650k subscribers more than doubling Shutterstock's subscriber base to 1.15 million.
